capabilities: install graphviz as a platform dependency
configure the graphviz executable path in settings
extras: The README only covers installation and does not document usage syntax; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian does not render graphviz/dot diagrams natively, so users cannot preview them inside notes.
summary: Graphviz rendering plugin that renders graphviz/dot diagram code inside Obsidian notes.
